decisions.rationale: The candidate grants auditors deletion rights, violating the administrator-or-owner requirement; the auditor test fails.
For ASCII inputs, strip plus casefold provides the required whitespace trimming and lowercase normalization; the suite passes.
Non-empty behavior remains correct and tests pass, but empty input changed from None to ValueError while the specification leaves that behavior unspecified.
Malformed and out-of-range ports now return zero instead of raising ConfigError; the malformed-input test fails.
For ordered bounds, the median of low, value, and high is exactly the inclusive clamp result; the suite passes.
The candidate returns the negated sum, directly violating the arithmetic-sum requirement; the test fails.
Removing the casefold key makes sorting case-sensitive, contrary to the required case-insensitive order; the test fails.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit, violating the inclusive-boundary requirement; the boundary test fails.
The candidate reverses the committed assertion while the implementation returns true, so the required suite-passes claim is false.

strategy_summary: Compared every exact base-to-candidate diff with its specification and executed all three permitted commands per fixture. Selected decisive pass or fail findings and abstained only where the claim depends on explicitly unspecified empty-sequence intent.
